name: blueprint-3d-sheet
description: Turn a 2D drawing, CAD file, photo, or written brief into ONE self-contained interactive 3D engineering sheet: orthographic plates, numbered callouts on leader lines, dimensions, a section cutaway, a full exploded view, live instrument readouts, and animated motions in a single offline index.html. The emitted page makes no network requests and contains no telemetry. Authoring, validating and building run entirely offline and need no API key; the only network access the toolchain requires is a first-time `npm install`, which may download a Chromium build via puppeteer. Evidence gathering from the web is NOT part of this release: the repository carries unfinished `bundle` and `research` code that can fetch URLs when you invoke it explicitly, but it is untested against real sources and is not a feature of this version — do not rely on it.
